apps.localizedDescription: Nectar is designed for reading fanfiction from Archive of Our Own, parsing all metadata like word count, chapters, fandom, rating, warnings, and series. It loads each work's full text with saved reading position, offline-friendly caching, and a distraction-free full screen reader. Add your own custom themes, leave kudos from the app, and save iconic quotes.
